founder.heading: Meet The Founder
founder.paragraph_1: Gabriela has been a Yoga Alliance Certified since 2020 and a teacher for many years throughout the Fraser Valley, becoming renown for her expertise, playfulness and ability to connect with her students.
founder.paragraph_2_mobile: She is very focused on building a unique approach to fitness and one that guides people into building a better life through strength.
founder.paragraph_2: She is very focused on building a unique approach to fitness and one that guides people into building not only a better body, but enjoying the journey of building a better life.
founder.paragraph_3: No Miracle diets. No Shortcuts. Gabi believes in a well balanced, disciplined routine that makes you live life on your own terms. All of that with a good dose of humor!

timeline.heading:
A journey through spirituality and
a better lifestyle
timeline.photo_1_alt: Gabriela in a yoga pose on a wooden block by the studio window
timeline.text_1: Gabriela’s teaching career starts with a search for purpose and a better lifestyle. She previously practiced Jiu Jitsu and Yoga, which although for a very brief moment, brought her immense joy and a sense of personal satisfaction.
timeline.text_2: Gabi traveled through Asia, including India and Cambodia, where she explored ancient yoga and meditation traditions and gained professional experience working at a retreat.
timeline.photo_2_alt: Gabriela taking part in a ceremony with monks during her travels in Asia
timeline.text_3: She later evolved that practice into a structured routine that she could follow and eventually transformed that into discipline and action that shifted her career into a different direction.

next_chapter.text: That teaching eventually bloomed into resilience, diligence and a work ethic. Now, Gabriela applies those same values into her classes to provide her students with a mindset of constant growth and knowledge.
next_chapter.text_mobile: That teaching eventually bloomed into resilience and diligence. Now, Gabriela applies those same values into her classes, providing her students with a mindset of constant growth and knowledge.
next_chapter.quote: “More than just strength training, I’ll share my knowledge and passion so you can build a high-energy journey with a caring community.”
next_chapter.photo_alt: Gabriela talking with a group sitting on the grass outdoors
next_chapter.photo_mobile_alt: Gabriela standing and talking with a group outdoors under the trees

next_chapter_2.photo_alt: Gabriela with tattooed arms raised, tying a ribbon among red prayer flags
next_chapter_2.text: Now, Gabriela’s new chapter is building a wellness centre that starts with FORGE Studio as a pivotal point to a more ambitious dream for the Fraser Valley community.
